name: mistral-ai
label: Mistral AI
description: Mistral AI provides state-of-the-art open-weight and hosted language models for text generation, embeddings, and reasoning tasks.

token.label: API Key
token.description: You can obtain your API key from the Mistral AI dashboard. Go to https://console.mistral.ai, generate an API key, and paste it here.

create_chat_completion.label: Ask Mistral
create_chat_completion.description: Ask a Mistral model a question and get its answer.

model.label: Model
model.description: The Mistral model that writes the reply.

prompt.label: Question
prompt.description: What you want the model to answer or do.

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.description: From 0 to 1.5. Lower is more focused, higher is more varied.

top_p.label: Top P
top_p.description: From 0 to 1. Adjust this or Temperature, not both.

max_tokens.label: Max Tokens
max_tokens.description: Longest reply in tokens, about 4 characters each.

random_seed.label: Random Seed
random_seed.description: Set a seed to make repeated calls return the same output.

timeout.label: Timeout
timeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for a response. Empty: 30 seconds.

list_models.label: List Models
list_models.description: Retrieves a list of available Mistral AI models.

complete_code_fim.label: Complete Code (Fill-in-the-Middle)
complete_code_fim.description: Generate the code that belongs between a prefix and an optional suffix with a Codestral model.

model.label: Model
model.description: A Codestral model id. Fill-in-the-middle only works with Codestral models.

prompt.label: Code Before (Prompt)
prompt.description: The code that comes before the part to generate.

suffix.label: Code After (Suffix)
suffix.description: Optional code that comes after the part to generate.

stop.label: Stop Sequences
stop.description: Stop generating when any of these strings is produced.

generate_speech.label: Generate Speech
generate_speech.description: Turn text into a spoken audio file.

voice_id.label: Voice
voice_id.description: A preset voice slug such as en_paul_neutral, en_paul_happy or en_paul_sad, or the UUID of a custom voice.

file_name.label: File Name
file_name.description: Name for the audio file, without extension.

list_files.label: List Files
list_files.description: List files uploaded to your Mistral account.

purpose.label: Purpose
purpose.description: Only return files uploaded for this purpose.

search.label: Search
search.description: Only return files whose name contains this text.

file_id.label: File ID
file_id.description: The file UUID, from List Files.

list_agents.label: List Agents
list_agents.description: List the Mistral agents in your organization (Beta).

search.label: Search
search.description: Only return agents whose name or id contains this text.

page_token.label: Page Token
page_token.description: The next page token from a previous call.

append_to_conversation.label: Append to Conversation
append_to_conversation.description: Send a follow-up message in an existing conversation (Beta).

conversation_id.label: Conversation ID
conversation_id.description: The conversation id (usually starts with conv_), from Start Conversation or List Conversations.

restart_conversation.label: Restart Conversation
restart_conversation.description: Branch a conversation from an earlier entry with a new message (Beta).

conversation_id.label: Conversation ID
conversation_id.description: The conversation id (usually starts with conv_), from Start Conversation or List Conversations.

from_entry_id.label: From Entry ID
from_entry_id.description: The entry to restart from, from Get Conversation History.

message.label: Message
message.description: The new user message to send from that point.

get_conversation_history.label: Get Conversation History
get_conversation_history.description: Get every entry of a conversation, including tool calls (Beta).

conversation_id.label: Conversation ID
conversation_id.description: The conversation id (usually starts with conv_), from Start Conversation or List Conversations.

get_conversation_messages.label: Get Conversation Messages
get_conversation_messages.description: Get the user and assistant messages of a conversation (Beta).

conversation_id.label: Conversation ID
conversation_id.description: The conversation id (usually starts with conv_), from Start Conversation or List Conversations.

list_libraries.label: List Libraries
list_libraries.description: List document libraries you can access (Beta).

search.label: Search
search.description: Only return libraries whose name contains this text.

page_token.label: Page Token
page_token.description: The next page token from a previous call.

list_library_documents.label: List Library Documents
list_library_documents.description: List the documents in a library (Beta).

library_id.label: Library ID
library_id.description: The library UUID, from List Libraries or Create Library.

search.label: Search
search.description: Only return documents whose name contains this text.

get_document_text_content.label: Get Document Text Content
get_document_text_content.description: Get the text Mistral extracted from a library document (Beta).

library_id.label: Library ID
library_id.description: The library UUID, from List Libraries or Create Library.

document_id.label: Document ID
document_id.description: The document UUID, from List Library Documents or Upload Library Document.
